findings.problem: The sentence leaves usar in the infinitive after puedo, but the card's own verb has to be conjugated in the example.
findings.fix: example.es: Uso mi teléfono todo el día. / example.en: I use my phone all day.

back.example: Can I use your phone for a moment?

note: Utilizar (more formal) and the regional ocupar (Mexico, Chile) also mean to use, but usar is the everyday answer everyone would give, so no hint is needed.
